model_output.rationale: Simile is a textbook thesis match: Greenoaks (Tier 1+) leads as genuinely new money into a Series B from an elite, AI-native founding team (generative-agents inventors). Financials are largely undisclosed/[ESTIMATED], but growth, logos, and TAM all support the round.
